patterns_observed: Pattern-interrupt opener: 'X is looking for Y' (where X is a household-name brand) → reveals it's actually Brodie
Short declarative sentences. Lots of single-line breaks for rhythm.
Stat blocks formatted vertically: '11,000+ games a year. / 20+ cities.'
Casual contractions and lowercase ('its not', 'man, this is it', 'a Killer')
Emojis used sparingly as punctuation, not decoration: 👀 🫥 👇 🏀
Always closes with a CTA: '👇' arrow + link or 'Dm me'
Self-deprecating jabs at incumbents: 'Sorry Adam Silver 🫥'
Frames Brodie in incumbent-comparable scale: 'NBA for the everyday athlete', '9× bigger than the NBA'
do_not_imitate: Corporate buzzwords: 'leverage', 'synergy', 'best-in-class' — use 'top of class' instead
Generic CTA language: 'reach out', 'connect with me' — use 'Dm me' or '👇'
Em-dashes in dialogue/narrative — Connor uses '...' for pauses
